chunks: But what is there so special they have that God should not punish them when they obstruct people from the Holy Mosque, though they are not its (appointed) guardians? Its guardians could be only those who are pious and devout. But most of them do not know.
ai.seo_question: Who are the true guardians of the Holy Mosque according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for distinguishing between physical custodianship and spiritual authority (wilayah al-‘am), asserting that piety (taqwa) is the sole criterion for true guardianship of the Sacred Mosque. It critiques the Quraysh’s claim to religious leadership based on lineage or geography, a concept that underpins the Shia understanding of the Imams as the true inheritors of spiritual authority. The mention of 'most of them do not know' highlights the widespread ignorance of this divine criterion among the broader community.
